I have implemented the changes to preserve full query state across TanStack Query core, fine-grained persisters, and framework adapters on the `fix/persister-restore-state` branch:

### Summary of Changes

1. **`createPersisterRestoreResult` in `@tanstack/query-core`**:
   - Added and exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L171-L183), [`isPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L185-L194), and [`PersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L161-L169) from [query.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/query.ts) and [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/index.ts) (re-exported by all framework adapters), and updated [`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L127-L147) in [types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/types.ts).
   - Updated [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L636-L702) so that when a persister returns a `PersisterRestoreResult`, the query adopts the restored `QueryState` directly with `fetchStatus: 'idle'` without invoking `setData` or triggering `QueryCache` `onSuccess`/`onSettled` callbacks. This preserves `status` (including `'error'`), `isRefetchError`, failure counts/reasons, timestamps, invalidation flags (`isInvalidated`), and infinite-query pagination state (`pages`, `pageParams`, `fetchMeta`).
   - Updated [`QueryObserver.createResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L597-L619), [`shouldFetchOnMount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L345-L375), and [`shouldFetchOptionally`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L326-L343) in [queryObserver.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts) so observer mounts on restored queries expose persisted failure counters and timestamps instead of resetting or recomputing them on mount.

2. **Fine-Grained Persister & Bulk Restoration Reconciliation in `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`**:
   - Updated [`persisterFn`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L387-L441) in [createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts) to return `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data: persistedQuery.state.data, state: persistedQuery.state })`.
   - Updated [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L334-L385) along with [`normalizePersistedState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L106-L157) and [`reconcileQueryStates`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L159-L238) to restore full `QueryState` snapshots and independently reconcile data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`, `data`, `dataUpdateCount`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`, `error`, `errorUpdateCount`, `fetchFailureCount`, `fetchFailureReason`) when merging with existing in-memory queries.

3. **Adapter Support & Tests**:
   - Updated [`useBaseQuery`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts#L129-L138) in [useBaseQuery.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts) so `vue-query` subscribes to the observer and syncs state even when used with a core `QueryClient`.
   - Added unit and integration tests across [query.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-core/src/__tests__/query.test.tsx), [createPersister.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersister.test.ts), [react-query/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx), [preact-query/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/preact-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx), [solid-query/useQuery.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/solid-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.tsx), [svelte-query/createQuery.svelte.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/svelte-query/tests/createQuery.svelte.test.ts), [vue-query/useQuery.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/vue-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.ts), and [angular-query-experimental/inject-query.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-72k0sncf/packages/angular-query-experimental/src/__tests__/inject-query.test.ts).
